name: 10 November: deciding how to judge before the result

Deciding how to judge before the result. One of the five warning checks in aspire-si's S2 v1.1 run went over its line at one reading. Two in a row would stop the run for review, and the study record didn't say how…

A second engine, checked first. vLLM could run our bulk jobs many requests at a time. A Deep Research report on it got two things wrong that we checked at source. The first trial got half-way: the speed sweep ran,…

Eight at a time isn't eight times faster. Batching the next study's evaluation pass by eight would make it about 2.15 times faster. Up to 35% of the time can go to a dozen answers that may never stop.

CLI trail new / trail continue memory parity (H-1) & canonical cause of death (M-1). Interactive CLI runs now emit memory cards (crises, health/death, wagon breakdowns, events, arrivals, escape valves, GM proposals)…
TUI Abandon Cargo toast & memory card (H-2). [V] Abandon Cargo in the TUI now displays the actual dropped supply counts instead of (dropped: nothing).
Fork route prompt timer tick (H-3). Choosing a route at a fork no longer consumes a turn of wagon maintenance or escape-valve cooldown before the travel day begins.

name: npm-launcher v1.2.0
body: Through a wrapper, --version, -V, --help and -h reach the tool (#6). 1.1.1 answered them before reading the wrapper's config, so npx @mcptoolshop/<tool> --version printed mcptoolshop-launch 1.1.1 instead of the…

The tool sees its own name. The binary is started with argv[0] set to the tool's name, so a tool's help reads Usage: xrpl-lab ... rather than Usage: xrpl-lab-2.7.9-win-x64.exe ..., the cached asset's file name. That…
--launcher-version prints the launcher's version, with or without a wrapper.
Seven pass-through tests (24 total), and a CI line-coverage floor at the measured level (target 90).
